# M2MBilling.com

Independent reference project on machine-to-machine billing, usage accounting, and billing reference structures.

## Canonical Resource

- [Home](https://m2mbilling.com/)

## Main Sections

- [Sources](https://m2mbilling.com/sources/)

## Purpose

M2MBilling.com provides an independent reference on machine-to-machine billing, usage accounting, billing models, and related reference structures.
